findings.title: Shared headers and layouts fail at 200% text
findings.evidence: At 320×568 logical pixels and 200% text, 220 of 251 route visits recorded RenderFlex overflow. Many share the same header defect; these are not 220 independent bugs. Account Centre visibly breaks labels into individual letters.
findings.action: Make headers, rows and bottom controls grow/wrap; avoid fixed heights for text. Recheck at 320/375/402 widths with 100/150/200% text.

findings.title: Phone verification crashes without navigation payload
findings.evidence: Opening /settings/personal/verify directly produces a null-check exception. Router casts s.extra! to String.
findings.action: Guard missing/invalid extra; return to contact-change start with a recovery message. Add direct-link and restoration tests.

findings.title: Deletion asks for confirmation before admitting it is unavailable
findings.evidence: The action asks for Delete with Face ID, then a real backend only shows a toast directing the user to Help. No deletion request is submitted there.
findings.action: Immediately label this as Request account deletion and open the real support path, or implement the approved deletion lifecycle before offering Delete.

findings.title: Font failure can prevent first app frame
findings.evidence: main awaits GoogleFonts.pendingFonts before runApp, with a timeout handler but no error handler. A fast network/font failure can propagate. Fresh offline startup was not reproduced on a wiped device.
findings.action: Bundle all used fonts; let startup render a fallback on any font error. Test fresh-install airplane mode.

findings.title: Venue times are displayed in device timezone
findings.evidence: Activity and competition repositories call toLocal(); this differs from the venue-time requirement and misleads travelers.
findings.action: Use venue/activity timezone consistently and show the zone when helpful. Test Singapore activity viewed in New Zealand and across DST.

findings.title: Some shared controls/text are below the design minimum
findings.evidence: Follow control has height 40; verified tag uses 11 px text; Passport includes 11 px labels. Design minimum is 44 px targets and 12 px text.
findings.action: Increase hit areas without necessarily enlarging visual pills; raise small type and run semantics/tap-target tests.

findings.title: Screen sweep can report success despite recorded screen errors
findings.evidence: The audit replaces FlutterError.onError and writes ERROR rows but never asserts that the error set is empty. The large-text run without screenshots passed despite hundreds of recorded overflows.
findings.action: Fail on unexpected route errors/overflows; explicitly allow expected redirects and mock native plugins.

findings.title: Route sweep misses newer features and depends on external fonts
findings.evidence: Existing list omits fitness, AI, analysis, videos and match rounds. Without valid font files the sweep used placeholder glyphs and falsely reported 22 overflow routes. Some medium-weight glyphs were still absent in screenshot mode.
findings.action: Bundle fonts, validate their presence, generate/verify route coverage, and isolate each route to prevent delayed plugin errors being attributed to the next screen.

findings.title: Feed API and race suites are absent from explicit CI lists
findings.evidence: CI runs clips but does not list supabase_feed_local_test.dart or feed_races.sh. Default flutter test skips API tests without local variables.
findings.action: Add feed API tests and the feed race script to required CI jobs, and assert expected integration-test counts.

findings.title: Database lint failures are blanket-advisory
findings.evidence: CI uses continue-on-error for all db lint errors. This run reported eight errors inside pgTAP extension helpers, not application-schema errors.
findings.action: Limit/allowlist known extension or temporary-table diagnostics and fail new public/private function errors.

findings.title: Real payment collection is not implemented end to end
findings.evidence: Hosted canCollect is false. Successful local money journeys use a stand-in, not Stripe test mode.
findings.action: Complete approved card/hosted payment UX, Connect onboarding and saved-method flows; validate webhook replay, late success, refunds and reconciliation against the real test provider.

findings.title: Push delivery and real code delivery are not proven
findings.evidence: Status docs state no push reaches a phone without Firebase; SMS/email real senders remain unproven.
findings.action: Connect development providers and test foreground/background delivery, deep links, opt-outs, quiet hours, token refresh and resend failures on devices.

findings.title: Real moderation and video hosting are missing
findings.evidence: Hosted posts cannot go live successfully without selected providers. Matching accuracy/outages are unmeasured.
findings.action: Keep flag off; implement real adapters, failure/retry monitoring and operational review before release.

findings.title: Uploaded video location metadata is not removed
findings.evidence: Existing status and Q226 say viewers receive the original file, which may include filming location. No fresh metadata attack was performed.
findings.action: Strip metadata or re-encode before public delivery; verify with a tagged iPhone sample and inspect the delivered file.

findings.title: Child appearance in adult posts has no reliable control
findings.evidence: After first-post reviews, the documented controls are uploader attestation and reports, not automatic age detection.
findings.action: Resolve Q212 with the owner and safety/legal reviewers before enabling public feed; specify moderation escalation and response ownership.

findings.title: Movement reports are not validated on real matches
findings.evidence: Worker tests pass but real-match accuracy is unproven; changing ends may cause tracking of the opponent.
findings.action: Validate a labeled real-clip set, detect/refuse end changes, expose confidence/limitations, and keep the feature gated until accuracy is acceptable.

findings.title: Long videos are rejected after uploading; uploads need app open
findings.evidence: Client length is a maximum placeholder and worker validates later. Closing the app interrupts upload.
findings.action: Measure duration/format before upload, show size/time expectations, support resumable uploads or clearly communicate foreground requirement.

findings.title: Court corners cannot be adjusted with a screen reader
findings.evidence: Documented corner dots are readable but drag-only for moving.
findings.action: Offer selected-corner nudge controls or numeric adjustment with spoken feedback; verify using VoiceOver/TalkBack.

findings.title: Real model response and data-transfer terms unvalidated
findings.evidence: Adapter is tested with a fake server; schema, quality, latency, token cost and account terms have not met the real provider.
findings.action: Run consented development test cases, validate schema/caps and quality, then obtain required review before enabling.

findings.title: In-progress plan does not survive app closure
findings.evidence: Returning within a session works, but app closure loses the pending request and a retry can consume another daily plan.
findings.action: Persist job/request id, recover status on launch and show quota usage before retry.

findings.title: Rest timer and save recovery are incomplete
findings.evidence: Timer resets on leaving screen and does not notify while closed; finished unsaved workouts need manual retry; server-rejected workouts may only be discarded.
findings.action: Persist timer deadline, clarify notification behavior, retain editable rejected drafts and provide safe automatic retry/status.

findings.title: Exercise guidance needs qualified review
findings.evidence: Catalogue, minor suitability and templates have not been coach-reviewed.
findings.action: Review and version exercise guidance, suitability and templates; do not describe current templates as validated.

findings.title: Shop totals and earnings detail rows do not reconcile visually
findings.evidence: Shop amounts are included in totals but activity-only rows omit shop sales.
findings.action: Add shop/lesson source rows and filters; every total should reconcile to visible/exportable entries.

findings.title: Discount changes the Items line when commission is on top
findings.evidence: Total is documented as correct, but item subtotal shifts because commission follows discounted price.
findings.action: Display item price, discount, commission and final total separately with consistent receipts.

findings.title: Promotional hero competes with the main player task
findings.evidence: Home screenshot devotes much of the first screen to a creator campaign before categories; Play also starts with hosting promotion. This is a design judgement, not a functional failure.
findings.action: Prioritize next session and Find a game; make hosting secondary for non-hosts and label demo-only offers. Test completion time with new players.

findings.title: Broad information architecture needs clearer entry points
findings.evidence: Play, Game, Fitness, Profile and Account Centre divide related sessions, rewards, progress and settings.
findings.action: Use task-oriented labels and consistent shortcuts for My sessions, My progress and Manage; test whether players can find each without instruction.

findings.title: Make empty and disabled states explain the next action
findings.evidence: Several categories are gated; demo visibility is richer than connected-app availability.
findings.action: For each flag-off/empty/permission/offline state say why and offer a useful alternative; do not imply a transaction can be completed.

findings.title: Long creation flows need explicit recovery testing
findings.evidence: Multiple-step Meet, tournament, club and academy forms exist; process-death recovery for all drafts was not verified.
findings.action: Test keyboard overlap, validation, back navigation, destructive exit confirmation and draft restoration; retain entered values on recoverable failure.

findings.title: Raw colors bypass centralized design tokens
findings.evidence: Raw Color literals remain in profile, shop, group chat and other screens even though design tests cover shared tokens.
findings.action: Move semantic colors into shared tokens, then compare full screens in both themes and with high text scale.

findings.title: Map hosting is still the public OpenStreetMap tile endpoint
findings.evidence: Find screen requests tile.openstreetmap.org; status docs explicitly flag production suitability.
findings.action: Choose and configure the approved production tile provider, attribution, caching and quota/failure handling.

findings.title: Required human reviews and device release checks remain unproven
findings.evidence: Status docs report agent reviews but no required human approvals. This audit did not verify app-store builds or hosted deployments.
findings.action: Complete the repository-required security/privacy/architecture reviews and two human money reviews; run real iOS/Android camera, biometrics, notification and payment checks.

findings.title: README and operational instructions lag the implementation
findings.evidence: README describes later phases as coming soon; current code reaches Phase 5d. It names a different hosted project than Env default.
findings.action: Document actual feature flags, implemented scope and local commands; remove ambiguous hosted setup instructions and nominate the authoritative development project. Do not use either hosted project during this audit.

findings.title: Data export and automated account lifecycle are unfinished
findings.evidence: Status docs state support deletion and no player export; video deletion must coordinate with pending checks.
findings.action: Implement the approved lifecycle across money, guardians, workouts, clips, posts and storage with export/download and deletion-status visibility.

findings.title: Long histories need pagination and useful filters
findings.evidence: Workout log documents latest-100 limit; feed documents 50-post list without paging.
findings.action: Add cursor pagination, clear date filters and count wording that distinguishes loaded rows from total records.

findings.title: Campaign editor supports only one quest
findings.evidence: Database and player app support multiple quests but staff editor creates one.
findings.action: Support adding/reordering/removing quest definitions with validation and a player-view preview.

findings.title: Error recovery and service health need a cross-feature review
findings.evidence: Many individual failure-state tests exist, but this session did not exercise every offline/process-death/error combination on devices.
findings.action: Standardize retry, saved/pending state and support references; run a device matrix for network loss during join/pay/save/upload without exposing personal data in logs.
